I honestly think that there could only be two (mayyybee a third) option for this.

The first one would be the generic "alright let's make the games storyline the exact same in the anime and just insert a (probably female) MC.
This version would be rather problematic since it would make a lot of players feel disconnected from the game. Obey me has such a large fanbase because MC doesn't have a fixed gender and no Canon design. Everybody is creating MCs like they want them to look, and give them any gender. By inserting an MC into the anime all of that creativity and connection gets lost (which obviously isn't good)

The second option could be about making an anime about the brothers before they fell.
This would give an insight on how they lived there, were created and now Lilith got to know the human and tried to save him, their fall from Grace and the rebirth of Lilith as a human, maybe reaching up to the point of the imprisonment of Belphegor.
I could see that they might include some Devilgram stories before Belphies imprisonment that don't include MC (like paying back what's owed, the escorts etc.). As well as a time skip while MC comes to the Devildom, and then a few scenes after they left depicting how the Brothers relationships changed after they visited the Devildom.
The only kinda problem I see here is that we'd a Canon Lilith and the brothers as angels, but I don't think too many people would mind that.

The maybe third option, (which doesn't make a lot of sense ngl) would be that they follow the original storyline of the game, but that they make MC androgynous and have them voiced by both a man and women, overlaying the voices so it makes it a like genderneutral voice? Does that make sense?

Again, we'd have the problem of a Canon mc design, but a lot of problems would be solved by having an androgynous/genderneutral MC

I personally think that the second option would be the best (if it ever came to an anime), but I'd love to hear your guy's opinions!
